🛠️ Practical Guide

The AI Tools Guide for D&A PMMs

What's available, what's licensed, and how to start using AI tools today. The survey showed the biggest blockers are awareness and access — not resistance. This guide fixes that.

📊 What the Survey Told Us

68%
eager for AI training
3.2

The data is clear: The team wants to learn, and we're starting from a reasonable baseline. The bottleneck isn't convincing people — it's showing them where to start.

🤖 Tools Available Now

These tools are available to our team today. Some require no additional setup — just sign in with your SAP credentials.

🤖

Microsoft Copilot

✅ Available now

Built into Microsoft 365. Use it to summarize documents, draft emails, create presentations, and answer questions about your files. No license request needed.

Open Copilot →
⚔️

CompeteGPT

✅ Available now

SAP's internal competitive intelligence tool. Search for competitors to surface win/loss patterns, positioning shifts, and battlecard-ready insights from CRM data.

Access CompeteGPT →
🔍

Perplexity Pro

🔑 Licensed

AI-powered research with source citations. Excellent for market research, competitive analysis, and fact-checking. The citations make it easy to verify and reference.

Open Perplexity →
🎨

Claude

🔑 Licensed

Anthropic's AI assistant. Particularly strong at long-form content, nuanced analysis, and following complex instructions. Great for positioning work and messaging frameworks.

Open Claude →
💬

ChatGPT

🔑 Licensed

OpenAI's flagship assistant. Versatile general-purpose AI for drafting, brainstorming, analysis, and creative tasks. The GPT-4 model handles complex reasoning well.

Open ChatGPT →
🧪

GenAI Experience Lab

✅ Available now

SAP's internal AI playground. Test different models, enable external search (includes Perplexity integration), and experiment with AI capabilities in a safe environment.

Open GenAI XL →

💡 Licensing note: Claude and ChatGPT are available via corporate license — see Irfan's email to the D&A team for access details. Perplexity Pro is in Phase 1 rollout with 110 licenses allocated to D&A.

⚡ Three Things to Try This Week

Pick one and spend 15 minutes with it. That's all it takes to build the muscle memory.

01

Open Copilot Chat

Use it to summarize your next analyst report or draft an internal email. No license needed — just sign in.

02

Run a CompeteGPT Query

Search for the competitor you're currently battlecarding. See what win/loss patterns and positioning shifts surface.

03

Try Perplexity

Research a market trend you've been meaning to dig into. Note the source citations — they're useful for positioning docs.

📋 Common Use Cases

Not sure where to start? Here's how other PMMs are using these tools:

📝 First Drafts

Use ChatGPT or Claude to draft blog posts, email copy, or presentation outlines. Edit from there instead of starting from scratch.

🎯 Competitive Intel

CompeteGPT for internal win/loss data. Perplexity for external market research with cited sources.

📊 Document Summaries

Drop analyst reports, earnings calls, or long PDFs into Copilot or Claude. Get key points in seconds.

💡 Brainstorming

Use any of the chat tools to generate messaging variations, positioning angles, or campaign ideas.

🔍 Research

Perplexity excels at market trends and competitor news. The citations make it easy to verify claims.

✍️ Writing Polish

Paste your draft and ask for tone adjustments, clarity improvements, or alternative phrasings.
